description: This is a Java class file implementing authentication services, including user registration and login functionalities within a Spring framework project. It interacts with a UserRepository, manages user credentials, and handles authentication logic.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class providing authentication functionalities such as user registration and login.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user after validating username uniqueness and creates a User entity with initial password setup.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying username and password, returning a mock token upon success.
